comment: Labelled emails for the urgency eval (P7). Every email arrives on the morning of Tue 2026-10-27, so 'today' is unambiguous. label: urgent (should interrupt now), important (worth telling, can wait for the hourly digest), not_important (never surface). 'why' explains the label for reviewers.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Interview moved to 3pm today
emails.text: Hi! Our hiring manager has a conflict, so could we move your final interview from tomorrow to today at 3pm PT? Please confirm by noon so I can send the new invite.
emails.why: Same-day schedule change with a noon reply deadline.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Your verification code
emails.text: Your Chase verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. Don't share this code with anyone.
emails.why: One-time security code that expires in minutes.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Security alert: new sign-in from Windows device
emails.text: Your Google Account was just signed in to from a new Windows device in Lagos, Nigeria. If this was you, you don't need to do anything. If not, we'll help you secure your account: review your activity now.
emails.why: Possible account compromise; acting fast matters.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Client call moved up to 11am - can you join?
emails.text: Northwind moved our call up to 11am today. Can you join and walk them through the pricing deck? Let me know in the next hour either way.
emails.why: Manager needs an answer within the hour for a call today.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Your flight today has been cancelled
emails.text: We're sorry: flight UA 1482 from SFO to DEN today, October 27, has been cancelled. Rebook on another flight by 2:00 PM PT today at no extra cost, or request a refund.
emails.why: Travel disruption today with a same-day rebooking deadline.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Please pick up Sam
emails.text: Sam has a fever of 101.2 and is resting in the health office. Per school policy, please pick him up as soon as possible. Call us at 555-0142 when you're on your way.
emails.why: A child needs to be picked up as soon as possible.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Emergency water shutoff at 1pm today
emails.text: Due to an emergency pipe repair, water to all units will be shut off today from 1pm until about 5pm. Please plan accordingly and store water if needed.
emails.why: Disruption today that the user needs to prepare for before 1pm.

emails.label: urgent
emails.subject: Need your wire approval before 5pm
emails.text: The supplier needs the deposit wired today or they release our production slot. The wire is queued in the bank portal and needs your approval before 5pm ET (2pm your time).
emails.why: Approval needed today with a hard afternoon deadline.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Offsite slides by Friday?
emails.text: Hi, could you send your five roadmap slides for next week's offsite by end of day Friday? Use the new template in the shared folder. Thanks!
emails.why: A real request, but the deadline is days away.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Q4 estimated tax payment
emails.text: Reminder that your Q4 estimated tax payment is due January 15. I've attached the voucher and my calculation; please review when you have a moment and let me know if anything changed this year.
emails.why: Needs attention, but the deadline is months away.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Your annual checkup is scheduled
emails.text: Your annual physical with Dr. Reyes is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18 at 10:00am. Reply to this email or call us if you need to reschedule.
emails.why: A real appointment three weeks out; nothing to do today.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Final round next week
emails.text: Great news: the team would like to move you to the final round next week. Could you send me a few times that work for you between Monday and Thursday?
emails.why: Matters for the user's job search, but it can wait an hour.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Your lease renewal offer
emails.text: Your lease ends on January 31. Attached is a renewal offer at the current rent for 12 months. Please let us know your decision by November 30.
emails.why: A decision with a deadline a month out.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Wedding RSVP - Dec 1
emails.text: Hey! Just a nudge that RSVPs for the wedding are due December 1. Hope you can make it - let us know if you're bringing a plus one.
emails.why: Personal request with a deadline weeks away.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Open enrollment closes Nov 15
emails.text: Benefits open enrollment is open until November 15. If you don't make changes, your current plans roll over, except the FSA, which requires a new election each year.
emails.why: Needs action before Nov 15, not today.

emails.label: important
emails.subject: Kitchen renovation quote
emails.text: Thanks for having me over last week. Attached is the quote for the kitchen renovation: $38,400 including cabinets and labor. Happy to walk through it whenever you have time.
emails.why: A significant decision with no time pressure.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: Your package has shipped
emails.text: Your order of 'USB-C cable, 2-pack' has shipped and will arrive Thursday. Track your package in Your Orders.
emails.why: Routine order update.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: Markets wobble as earnings roll in
emails.text: Good morning. Stocks dipped yesterday as big tech earnings landed. Plus: the best fall hikes, and why everyone is suddenly talking about tinned fish.
emails.why: Newsletter.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: Today only: 40% off sweaters
emails.text: It's sweater weather. Take 40% off all sweaters today only with code COZY. Free shipping on orders over $75.
emails.why: Marketing. 'Today only' is a sales tactic, not a deadline for the user.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: [acme/web] Bump lodash from 4.17.20 to 4.17.21 (#482)
emails.text: dependabot[bot] opened a pull request: Bumps lodash from 4.17.20 to 4.17.21. You're receiving this because you're watching this repository.
emails.why: Automated low-impact notification.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: You appeared in 12 searches this week
emails.text: Your profile was found by people from Stripe, Notion and 4 other companies. See who's looking.
emails.why: Engagement bait.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: Your Tuesday morning trip with Uber
emails.text: Thanks for riding, Ben. Total: $14.20. Pickup 8:12am at 220 Oak St, drop-off 8:31am at 500 Howard St.
emails.why: Generic receipt.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: New music Friday is here
emails.text: Fresh releases from artists you love are waiting in your Release Radar. Press play.
emails.why: Marketing.

emails.label: not_important
emails.subject: Trending in Bernal Heights: lost cat
emails.text: A neighbor posted: 'Has anyone seen a gray tabby near Precita Park?' 14 neighbors have replied.
emails.why: Neighborhood digest with nothing for the user to do.
